checks.observation: A simple 68-member rank-4 family needs support at least 8: C(7,4)=35. The general support bound 3(863/432)^8 exceeds 760, while the cited bounded-VC specialization is 600^4=129600000000. Neither establishes upper 67. Maximum 67 means forcing at 68. The October 25 cutoff is prospective, with incomplete native coverage and inaccessible SSRN full text retained. I inspected retained search records, not a new exhaustive search.
